description: Look up one color by its code in a palette, e.g. DMC 310, Miyuki DB0010 (also written DB10 or DB-010), Perler P38, Hama H18, MARD A1. Returns the name, hex and RGB.

code.description: The color code as printed on the bag, tube or skein.

palette.description: Palette ids or names (e.g. "dmc", "delica", "perler", "mard"). Ids: perler-midi, hama-midi, artkal-s, nabbi, mard-185, mard-221, mard-291, miyuki-delica, dmc-floss, dmc-diamond, lego, minecraft-blocks, minecraft-map, red-heart-super-saver, pixel-art-256.

name: get_color
title: Look up a color code
